summary:
ASTRA is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and wellness system designed to support the physical and mental well-being of astronauts during long-duration space missions.
Astronauts in space face several challenges, including microgravity, radiation exposure, isolation, confinement, and sleep disturbances. These conditions can affect their physical health and mental wellness.
We developed ASTRA as a unified platform that includes astronaut profile management, daily health checkups, physical health monitoring, mental wellness tracking, health trends, alerts, reports, and an AI-powered health assistant. It brings important health information together in one place, helping users monitor changes, identify potential concerns, and understand health-related insights.
ASTRA aims to improve health awareness and support informed decision-making during space missions. By making astronaut health information easier to monitor and understand, our project contributes towards safer and healthier long-duration human space exploration.
details:
About ASTRA

ASTRA is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and wellness system developed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It provides a unified platform to monitor and understand different aspects of astronaut health.

How It Works

ASTRA allows users to manage astronaut profiles and record daily health checkups. It includes physical health monitoring, mental wellness tracking, health trends, alerts, reports, and an AI-powered health assistant. The platform organizes health information in one place, helping users observe changes and identify potential health concerns.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Astronauts may experience health challenges due to microgravity, radiation exposure, isolation, confinement, and disrupted sleep patterns. ASTRA aims to improve health awareness by making important health information easier to access and understand. It supports informed decision-making and contributes towards safer and healthier long-duration space missions.

Tools and Technologies Used

We developed ASTRA using:

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite
  • Backend: Node.js and Express.js
  • Database: MongoDB
  • AI Integration: Google Gemini API
  • Development Tools: Visual Studio Code and Codex

Creativity and Innovation

ASTRA brings physical health monitoring, mental wellness tracking, health insights, and AI assistance together in a single platform. Instead of treating these areas separately, it provides a connected approach to astronaut well-being.

Factors Considered

Our team considered the unique challenges of space environments, including microgravity, radiation, isolation, confinement, sleep disruption, and the importance of continuous health awareness. We also focused on creating a simple, user-friendly interface that makes health information easier to monitor and understand.

ASTRA aims to contribute to the future of human space exploration by supporting astronaut well-being beyond Earth.
